rules: Use this theme consistently across all Life lessons unless a future course-level override is approved.
All essential reading text uses near-black dark blue for large-room projector readability.
Use accent colours for activity type, answer state, diagrams and illustration; never make an entire lesson monochrome green.
Use the platform default Poppins font.
Projector view is the typography baseline; mobile layouts reflow rather than shrinking essential text excessively.
Answers appear inside their activity box or by highlighting the correct option, never as detached answer text below a task.
Student Book activity numbering stays visible on every source-derived task screen.
